MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Nov 18, 2026
SCHEDULED CASH SHOP MAINTENANCE - NOVEMBER 19, 2026

MapleStory Classic World will be performing a Cash Shop maintenance starting on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 5:00 AM PST (8:00 AM EST / 2:00 PM CET / 12:00 AM AEDT November 20). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 3 hours concluding around 8:00 AM PST (11:00 AM EST / 5:00 PM CET / 3:00 AM AEDT November 20).

This maintenance will not affect your access to log in or play MapleStory Classic World.

Times:

Thursday, November 19, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 5:00 AM - 8:00 AM
EST (UTC -5): 8:00 AM - 11:00 AM
CET (UTC +1): 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 AM November 20 - 3:00 AM November 20

What will be unavailable:

MapleStory Classic World Cash Shop and Billing/Payments

MAINTENANCE
Nov 18, 2026
SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH - NOVEMBER 19, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch starting on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 5:00 AM PST (8:00 AM EST / 2:00 PM CET / 12:00 AM AEDT November 20). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 8 hours, concluding around 1:00 PM PST (4:00 PM EST / 10:00 PM CET / 8:00 AM AEDT November 20).

Times:

Thursday, November 19, 2026
PST (UTC -8): 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM
EST (UTC -5): 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 12:00 AM - 8:00 AM November 20

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.
MapleStory Classic World will not be affected.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.272.3.0.
Monthly Windows Update.
Full list of changes and updates will be provided here after the maintenance is complete.

items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Nov 18, 2026
MAC OS BETA KNOWN ISSUES AND UPDATES

The macOS Beta update list focuses on all changes and updates for macOS users during the Beta service. Please check the Known Issues section below for any current issues affecting the macOS Beta, and the Updates section for what was updated and changed. Make sure to close and restart your client after an update to ensure you are on the latest build.

Known Issues:
MacOS users who have updated to macOS 27 Golden Gate are unable to access MapleStory through Steam.
We advise players to download and install MapleStory directly from the Nexon Launcher, which will prompt the Rosetta install needed to access the game. Once Rosetta is installed, MapleStory can be accessed from Steam as normal.
Some players have reported experiencing drop in FPS while playing through the macOS client.
We recommend turning off all in-game sound related settings as it may help alleviate this issue.
The macOS keyboard shortcut Cmd+M can be activated while playing with 'Auto Key Activation' enabled, causing the game client to minimize.
Updates:

November 18, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.41.
MapleStory Classic World:
Resolved an issue where typing in Korean required pressing Enter, Tab, or Space after every character.

October 21, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.39.
Resolved an issue where the Nexon launcher window would not restore when clicking its icon after being minimized.
Resolved an issue where the 'close app' button was unavailable on the Steam launcher.
Resolved an issue where Game Key Mode would not function when launching through Steam.
MapleStory Classic World:
Resolved a full-screen display issue that occurred on certain screen aspect ratios when launching through Steam.

October 5, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.38.
Added support for MapleStory Classic World on Nexon launcher.
Added support for MapleStory Classic World on Steam launcher.
Added Game Key Mode.

August 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.32.
MapleStory Classic World:

Resolved an issue where the top menu bar appeared in full-screen mode on certain non-widescreen monitors
Resolved an issue causing game controller malfunctions

July 14, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.31.
Minor adjustments to client stability.

July 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.30.
Resolved an issue where launching MapleStory through Steam would incorrectly display black borders.

June 17, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.28.
Updated to support Discord Connect feature for macOS.

June 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.27.
Resolved an issue where the background for the End User License Agreement was discolored when installing through Steam.
Resolved an issue where the error message for having an outdated client would not show when launching through Steam.

May 21, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.26.
Adjusted for Steam Client Support.

April 30, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.25.
Resolved an issue where a prompt would not show properly in dark mode during the first install.

April 9, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.24.
Resolved an issue where jumping would persist when repeating commands.
Adjusted the Dock Icon and Menu Bar.

February 4, 2026

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.21.
NGS will be updated to 5.3.38.0.

December 19, 2025

The macOS client was updated to v.0.0.20.
Resolved an issue where there was a discrepancy with available disc space after installation
items.bodyZh:
维护公告
2026年11月18日
MAC OS BETA 已知问题与更新

macOS Beta 更新列表主要汇总 Beta 服务期间针对 macOS 用户的所有改动与更新。请查看下方“已知问题”部分，了解当前影响 macOS Beta 的问题；并查看“更新”部分，了解已更新和更改的内容。更新后请务必关闭并重新启动客户端，以确保您使用的是最新版本。

已知问题：
已更新至 macOS 27 Golden Gate 的 MacOS 用户无法通过 Steam 访问 MapleStory。
我们建议玩家直接从 Nexon Launcher 下载并安装 MapleStory，届时会提示安装访问游戏所需的 Rosetta。安装 Rosetta 后，即可像往常一样通过 Steam 访问 MapleStory。
部分玩家反馈，通过 macOS 客户端游玩时出现 FPS 下降的情况。
我们建议关闭所有游戏内与声音相关的设置，这可能有助于缓解该问题。
在启用“自动按键激活”时，macOS 键盘快捷键 Cmd+M 可能会被触发，导致游戏客户端最小化。
更新：

2026年11月18日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.41。
MapleStory Classic World：
修复了输入韩语时每输入一个字符都需要按 Enter、Tab 或空格键的问题。

2026年10月21日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.39。
修复了 Nexon 启动器窗口最小化后点击其图标无法恢复的问题。
修复了 Steam 启动器上“关闭应用”按钮不可用的问题。
修复了通过 Steam 启动时 Game Key Mode 无法正常运行的问题。
MapleStory Classic World：
修复了通过 Steam 启动时，在某些屏幕宽高比下出现的全屏显示问题。

2026年10月5日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.38。
新增对 Nexon 启动器上 MapleStory Classic World 的支持。
新增对 Steam 启动器上 MapleStory Classic World 的支持。
新增 Game Key Mode。

2026年8月4日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.32。
MapleStory Classic World：

修复了在某些非宽屏显示器上全屏模式下出现顶部菜单栏的问题
修复了导致游戏控制器故障的问题

2026年7月14日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.31。
对客户端稳定性进行了小幅调整。

2026年7月9日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.30。
修复了通过 Steam 启动 MapleStory 时错误显示黑边的问题。

2026年6月17日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.28。
更新以支持 macOS 的 Discord Connect 功能。

2026年6月4日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.27。
修复了通过 Steam 安装时最终用户许可协议背景变色的问题。
修复了通过 Steam 启动时，客户端版本过旧的错误提示不显示的问题。

2026年5月21日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.26。
针对 Steam 客户端支持进行了调整。

2026年4月30日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.25。
修复了首次安装期间深色模式下提示框无法正常显示的问题。

2026年4月9日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.24。
修复了重复执行命令时跳跃持续触发的问题。
调整了程序坞图标和菜单栏。

2026年2月4日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.21。
NGS 将更新至 5.3.38.0。

2025年12月19日

macOS 客户端已更新至 v.0.0.20。
修复了安装后可用磁盘空间存在差异的问题
